g.text: Codex / Sol: ten repeats of five tasks per mode
Each point: one repeat averaged over five tasks. Thick line: mean of ten repeats. Triangle: repeat includes a timeout.
V2/V3 ran earlier; Native/Paper later. All outcomes retained; 15-minute task limit. Calls are not a direct clock.
